_doc: Curated technique seeds (knowledge_architecture.md section 5), one file per area. Fields: id, level + scope (a scope node or universal), aliases (v1 / technique-DB / footer names folded in), mechanism, preconditions (predicate DSL), predicts (canonical metric -> up|down|flat|up_or_flat|down_or_flat), risks (pitfalls), states / op_classes / op_kinds gates (empty = any), slot (offered by the multi-slot agent), prior {mean, n}: a seed prior with a low pseudo-count that evidence overrides, realizations by scope (target:<key> | target:<backend>:sm_NN+ | target:<backend> | node:<id> | universal). Loaded by Ontology.seed(); scripts/seed_knowledge.py builds a knowledge.db from these files.

techniques.mechanism: read-heavy 2D operands through image2d_t: the texture path has its own L1 and handles 2D locality and boundary clamping
risks: image formats (CL_RGBA, CL_FLOAT / CL_HALF_FLOAT) pack 4 channels per texel; width limits (16384)
the driver must create the image; slots that only get buffers can use cl_khr_image2d_from_buffer

realizations.how: Weights / activations as image2d_t (RGBA: 4 channels per texel) read with read_imagef(img, sampler, (int2)(x, y)); outputs stay buffers.

techniques.mechanism: on Adreno __local is not much faster than the L1/texture path and costs barriers: block in registers first and use local memory only for real cross-work-item reuse
risks: register pressure lowers the kernel's max work-group size

realizations.how: Each work-item computes a 4x4 (float4 x 4) output block from vload4 rows read directly from global / image memory; add __local tiling only if profiling shows repeated global reads.

techniques.mechanism: pin the subgroup to a full (or half) 64-wide wave so subgroup reductions and broadcasts map to one wave
Adreno ALUs run half at twice the float rate: elementwise and activation math in half / half4 where the tolerance allows
risks: fp32 problems: half intermediate rounding (~1e-3) can exceed the bound; accumulate reductions in float

realizations.how: #pragma OPENCL EXTENSION cl_khr_fp16 : enable; vload_half4 / convert_half4 for the math, float accumulators for sums.

techniques.mechanism: fused multiply-add instructions instead of separate multiply and add

realizations.how: fmaf / __fmaf_rn in inner products (nvcc contracts by default unless --fmad=false).
